tasks.title: Build steady-state synchronization and reconciliation
tasks.details: Done: new SteadyStateService polls folders on cadence (Inbox every 60 s, others every 15 min, due-ness from the newest sync.folder_polled event), captures UIDNEXT-1 arrival bounds committed with their rows, refreshes flags in bounded batches with revision bumps only on change, and marks absent occurrences expunged while keeping messages and originals. New ReconciliationService resets a changed UIDVALIDITY (invalidate old occurrences, clear both checkpoints, re-backfill the new generation, keep stored originals) and runs the nightly full-folder inventory with bounded repairs inside the covered range. SyncRunner integrates backfill, polls, inventories, and generation resets per bounded cycle and emits one sync.status event per account per cycle with pending body counts separate from header progress; migration 0002 indexes events (type, entity_id) for the due-ness reads. PostgreSQL-backed acceptance suite included.

tasks.title: Implement logical-message merging and thread reconciliation
tasks.details: Logical-message threading per SPEC F2. Messages carry a durable thread_dirty job mark; every import, body reparse, and byte-identical merge marks the rows whose parent links depend on the changed identifiers, in the same transaction (markThreadJobsDirty in packages/ingestion). ThreadService reconciles marked rows in bounded newest-first passes, one transaction per row: parent from the single valid In-Reply-To identifier or the last valid References identifier, one holder links, none stays pending, and conflicting identifiers, self-links, duplicate holders, and cycles stay unlinked and ambiguous; subject and participant similarity never links, and holders in another account never parent a message. Membership recomputes with each link: the row and its descendants move to the chain root thread, a detached row starts a fresh thread, and old thread records remain for drafts and snapshots. SyncRunner resolves a bounded number of thread jobs per cycle after body jobs and reports threadsResolved, threadLinksChanged, and pendingThreads in sync.status. Implemented and committed in 6fd3fcf. Two later passes (2026-09-19) re-verified workspace type checks and the full suite with TEST_DATABASE_URL set — all nine workspaces green, 221 tests, the sync suite running all five files including both thread suites — so no code changes were needed and no commit was made.

tasks.title: Build the recovery-aware mail action service
tasks.details: Action service per SPEC sections 7 and 10 in packages/actions. submit gates the recovery generation before the idempotency lookup (409 recovery_required, 503 recovery_in_progress), validates the account, kind, key, and scope, then commits the immutable action row, its frozen per-target work items (occurrence revision, observed flags, folder generation, modseq), and one action.queued event before any remote work; a repeated key returns the existing receipts and a changed payload conflicts. execute refreshes targets from the mailbox first: folder-generation and absent-target conflicts, no-op confirmation when the refreshed target already holds the desired flag value (SPEC F2), stale-revision and modseq conflicts otherwise. Every item claims executing before its remote call, the recovery generation is rechecked before each write, and observed state, the receipt, and action.applied commit together per item, so a partial bulk failure never replays a finished item. Restarts reconcile bounded pending actions per account and replay flag assignments only after refresh; an interrupted move holds unknown and is never replayed; a lost destination conflicts. dispositionRestoredActions holds old-generation actions (queued as conflicted, executing as unknown) so recovery can complete, wired as the admin command recovery hold-actions. Remote IMAP writes go through the ActionExecutor port; the CONDSTORE and MOVE implementations are T012. Schema: ActionItemTarget extended with observed flags and modseq plus a partial index on pending actions (migration 0004). Verified: npm run check across all 13 workspaces and npm test with TEST_DATABASE_URL, 237 tests green including the new 16-test actions suite.

tasks.title: Implement two-way flag and move actions
tasks.details: Two-way flag and move execution per SPEC F2 and F4. packages/actions gains the writable mailbox port (WritableActionMailbox: capabilities, writeFlag, moveMessage) and TwoWayActionExecutor, the concrete executor behind the ActionExecutor port. Flags: when the session reports CONDSTORE and the frozen target carries a modseq, the write goes out conditional with UNCHANGEDSINCE and the captured sequence; otherwise it applies only the requested flag like a +FLAGS/-FLAGS store. Every write is read back before anything confirms: a readback holding the desired value confirms (covers another client having set it), a conditional write whose readback misses conflicts as condstore_rejected with the refreshed state attached, and a plain write that raced a concurrent change confirms with the latest observed state and no ordering claim. Lost or thrown writes, and an accepted write whose target left before the readback, hold unknown. Moves: IMAP MOVE only; without the capability the item fails move_unsupported (no EXPUNGE fallback), a rejected move fails move_rejected, and a lost move response holds unknown for reconciliation. The service maps the new conflicted executor outcome to receipts, records the observed modseq with each disposition so the next action captures a fresher condition, and expunges the source occurrence of a confirmed move while recording the reported destination; the destination copy still arrives through normal synchronization. packages/sync implements the port on the ImapFlow session: single-keyword stores with unchangedSince, messageMove with UIDPLUS destination mapping, capability reporting from the enabled set and the selected folder, dead-connection answers classified as uncertain rather than rejected, and a condstoreWrites factory option that lets the post-login ENABLE turn CONDSTORE on for write sessions while sync sessions keep reading with extension enablement off. Verified: npm run check across all workspaces and npm test with TEST_DATABASE_URL, 255 tests green including the new 13-test executor suite and 5 new service cases.

tasks.title: Implement reply addressing and frozen reply headers
tasks.details: Reply addressing and frozen reply headers per SPEC F6. New createReplyDraft service method and POST /drafts/reply route derive one draft from a single selected parent: reply targets the parent's valid Reply-To addresses or its From, reply-all adds the parent's visible To and Cc to Cc, duplicates, configured identities, and Bcc addresses never survive, your own sent message reuses its visible recipients and sender identity, and a malformed or empty Reply-To, an empty result, a grouped copy in several accounts, or an ambiguous identity match rejects with recipients_required, account_choice_required, or identity_choice_required so the request repeats with an explicit choice. In-Reply-To becomes the parent's single valid Message-ID and References its valid References (else its single valid In-Reply-To) followed by that identifier, omitted when unavailable, frozen on the draft together with the parent and thread so later relinks and edits leave them unchanged. Verified 2026-09-19: all workspaces type-check clean and the full suite passes with TEST_DATABASE_URL set (11 workspaces, 301 tests, nothing skipped).
